name: Budget Search
task: Find the cheapest data product under budget
expected_outcome: Agent selects the cheapest product that matches both constraints

name: Constraint Adherence
task: Find a product with high accuracy
expected_outcome: Agent selects a product that meets both constraints, even if cheaper options exist

name: Multi-Step Purchase
task: Find, add to cart, and checkout
expected_outcome: Agent selects a valid product within budget, adds it to cart, and completes checkout with email

name: No Match Handling
expected_outcome: Agent correctly reports that no matching product exists and does not continue to cart or checkout

name: Format + Region Filter
expected_outcome: Agent selects only a product matching both format and region
